articles.title: Asian shares trade mixed as markets continue to watch AI stocks and oil prices
articles.description: Asian shares are trading mixed after artificial-intelligence stocks slid overnight. Benchmarks rose in early Tuesday trading in Tokyo and Shanghai, but fell in Sydney and Hong Kong, while being little changed in Seoul. The markets are closely watching AI stocks after leaders of the industry warned a slowdown is needed for the safety of humanity. Gains for many stocks outside AI helped limit Wall Street’s losses. The S&P 500 fell 0.5%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 0.3%, and the Nasdaq composite lost 0.6%. Oil prices have continued to climb as fighting in the Middle East keeps squeezing the global flow of crude.
